DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).

The bone marrow biopsy confirming blasts with CD10, CD19, and TdT positivity, combined with pancytopenia and organomegaly, provides definitive evidence for this diagnosis. We will proceed immediately with flow cytometry and genetic profiling to guide treatment.
